name: Analytical Problem Solving
description: Break down ambiguous behavior, identify high-risk cases, isolate failure causes, and explain evidence-based conclusions.

name: API Testing
description: Validate REST or service behavior, HTTP methods and status codes, payloads, authentication, error handling, and boundary cases.

name: Test Automation Engineering
description: Design reliable, maintainable automated suites; choose appropriate test layers; manage test data, flakiness, and useful reporting.

name: Communication and Collaboration
description: Explain findings clearly, collaborate across engineering and product teams, and communicate risk, tradeoffs, and status.

name: Mobile Automation
description: Automate native or hybrid mobile flows, diagnose synchronization and device issues, and discuss Appium or equivalent tooling.

name: Web UI Automation
description: Build resilient browser tests using stable selectors, synchronization, and maintainable page or component patterns; discuss Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, or Cypress.

name: Manual and Exploratory Testing
description: Explore user workflows, use risk-based and boundary testing, reproduce issues, and adapt test ideas as new evidence emerges.

name: CI/CD Test Integration
description: Integrate appropriate tests into build and deployment pipelines, interpret failures, and improve feedback time using tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.

name: API Test Automation
description: Implement maintainable service-level checks for contracts, positive and negative cases, data setup, and regression using tools such as REST Assured or equivalent libraries.

name: Test Design and Coverage
description: Translate requirements into clear scenarios, prioritize by risk, use suitable test techniques, and identify meaningful coverage gaps.

name: Defect Investigation and Management
description: Produce reproducible defect reports with expected and actual results, useful evidence, impact, and severity; verify fixes and manage regression risk.

name: SQL and Data Validation
description: Use SQL and data reasoning to validate persistence, relationships, transformations, and consistency across application or service boundaries.

name: Programming and Scripting
description: Write and debug readable test code, use core language constructs and data structures, and explain design choices in a relevant language such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python.

name: Test Strategy and Risk Planning
description: Define scope, test levels, risk-based priorities, environments, dependencies, and exit criteria for a delivery or release.

name: Quality Reporting and Metrics
description: Interpret coverage, defect trends, escape risk, and execution results; communicate limitations without treating raw counts as quality by themselves.

name: Technical Leadership and Mentoring
description: Guide quality practices, review test approaches, coach teammates, resolve delivery risks, and balance hands-on technical contribution with team outcomes.

name: Stakeholder and Delivery Management
description: Coordinate dependencies and test readiness, raise risks early, align quality decisions with product needs, and provide actionable delivery updates.

name: Mobile Application Testing
description: Assess Android and iOS behavior across devices, OS versions, permissions, connectivity, lifecycle, accessibility, and compatibility conditions.

name: Performance Test Engineering
description: Plan load, stress, and endurance tests; define measurable objectives and workload profiles; create scripts and interpret results using tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner, or NeoLoad.

name: Performance Analysis and Diagnostics
description: Correlate latency, throughput, errors, resource use, logs, and traces to identify bottlenecks and communicate evidence-based tuning recommendations.

name: OTT and Media Workflow Expertise
description: Understand OTT platform architecture and media workflows, including content ingestion and metadata, encoding and packaging, DRM, CDN delivery, subscriptions and advertising, and live and on-demand playback.

name: Streaming Quality and Compatibility Testing
description: Plan and assess end-to-end streaming tests across web, mobile, and connected-TV devices, including playback startup, adaptive bitrate, buffering, live events, DRM, network conditions, and QoE measures using appropriate device labs, network tools, and observability.

name: Project and Release Management
description: Plan and track test delivery, environments, dependencies, resources, and release readiness; coordinate execution and communicate go/no-go risks and status to stakeholders.
